$comment: Machine-readable description of the Python environment that openEO Studio gives to user code. Studio sends this file to the agent in the AG-UI `context` field. Keep it in sync with loader.py; test/utils/loader-contract.test.ts checks this.
summary: Studio joins three parts before it runs the code: a RUN_CONFIG object, the loader script, then the code of the user. The agent must return the third part only.

symbols.name: datacube
symbols.description: The result of load_collection, with the four parameters applied.

symbols.name: reduced
symbols.description: The data cube after apply_pixel_selection with pixel_selection='first'.

symbols.name: add_graph_to_map
symbols.description: Add a process graph to the map. The code must call this function at least once, or the run produces no layer.

symbols.name: bounding_box
symbols.description: The spatial extent of the project. subtype: bounding-box.

symbols.name: time
symbols.description: The temporal extent of the project. subtype: temporal-interval.

symbols.name: bands
symbols.description: The band names of the project.

symbols.name: cloud_cover_max
symbols.description: The maximum cloud cover. The loader uses it in an eo:cloud_cover property filter.

symbols.name: parameters
symbols.description: The four Parameter objects above, in the order used by the saved user-defined process.

rules.description: Do not open a connection to a backend. Studio supplies the data cube.
Do not start a batch job and do not download a result. Studio runs the code in the browser.
Do not load a second collection. Studio supports one load_collection only. Refer to issue #85.
Call add_graph_to_map(graph, name) at least once.
